decision: Eligible two-point domestic FTE comparison with method caveat
population: Game studios in Finland; entrepreneurs included; overseas staff separate
method: Interviews plus other sources to estimate entire industry.134 studios interviewed2022;71 interviewed2024 plus public-source coverage. Not a constant respondent panel.
